name: dev-standards
description: Coding standards enforced by tools: a PostToolUse hook runs ruff (bandit rules), shellcheck and gitleaks on each edited file and feeds back only the findings that edit introduced. A short skill names the references (OWASP ASVS, CWE Top 25, PEP 8, Google Shell Style). sync-repo.sh copies the same hook into a repo so Claude Code on the web enforces it too.
